offline_policy_evaluation.note: Unbiased estimates need logged propensities below 1: run the A/B control arm or set KLASSED_BANDIT_EXPLORATION_EPSILON > 0.

score_prediction_validation.what: latest score prediction made at least 7 days before the exam vs the student's real NEET score
score_prediction_validation.how_to_supply_results: data/training/neet_actual_scores.csv with columns student_id, exam_year, exam_date, actual_score (collected with consent)

fairness.what: next-answer prediction quality (BKT) and score-range accuracy, split by student group
fairness.how_to_supply_attributes: data/training/student_attributes.csv (student_id plus any of language, region, state, device, gender, board, school_type), collected with consent; class_level is read from the students table

anomalies.what: patterns that suggest guessing without reading, answer copying, or answers inconsistent with a student's level

methods.person_fit: lz* statistic on the 3PL model (flag below -2.33, about the lowest 1%)
methods.rapid_guessing: answer faster than 10% of the item's expected time (min 5s); flag a student when over 30% of answers are rapid
methods.answer_copying: pairs on the same paper whose identical wrong options are very unlikely by chance (binomial p < 1e-06)

anomalies.use: flags are for human review only; never penalise a student automatically

knowledge_tracing_challenger.challenger: PFA (per-chapter logistic regression on prior successes and failures)
knowledge_tracing_challenger.protocol: students split 80/20 by student; one-step-ahead prediction on held-out students
knowledge_tracing_challenger.deep_models: SAKT/AKT are not trained: they need about 1,000,000 responses to beat these baselines reliably
